
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qiuzhendezhen/p/19180717" title="发布于 2025-10-31 17:26">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">rtpengine作为媒体代理的一个问题</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><img alt="头图-78" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2500940/202510/2500940-20251031172540971-1838363165.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<h1 id="RdeO4"><span class="ne-text">概述</span></h1>
<p id="u59e9bc5f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">使用kamailio+rtpengine的过程中，发现一个DTMF传输的问题，会造成DTMF传送错误。</span></p>
<p id="u7318f937" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">主要原因是AB路的rfc2833的payload有差异造成的，可以通过kamailio的配置逻辑来修复。</span></p>
<h1 id="tZals"><span class="ne-text">环境</span></h1>
<p id="u008440b8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">CentOS 7.9</span></p>
<p id="u3ab17135" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kamailio:5.8.3-bullseye docker</span></p>
<p id="u852f4443" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">rtpengine:mr13.1.1.6-4 docker</span></p>
<h1 id="R2wWP"><span class="ne-text">问题</span></h1>
<p id="u7b0b4cf5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kamailio 5.8.3 + rtpengine 13.1.1.6，媒体代理模式。</span></p>
<p id="uef056261" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">A路invite的sdp中dtmf参数如下。</span></p>
<p id="u775e7576" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">m=audio 45540 RTP/AVP 8 18 97</span></p>
<p id="u0e4d411e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a=rtpmap:97 telephone-event/8000</span></p>
<p id="u4677f923" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a=fmtp:97 0-15</span></p>
<p id="u8532f924" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u25832d6d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">经过kamailio转发后的invite的sdp。</span></p>
<p id="ubcaaf844" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">m=audio 33088 RTP/AVP 8 18 97</span></p>
<p id="u50c0782c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a=rtpmap:97 telephone-event/8000</span></p>
<p id="uc3cba648" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a=fmtp:97 0-15</span></p>
<p id="u0dd9fc4f" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u32e32f38" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">B路响应的200OK的sdp中dtmf参数如下。</span></p>
<p id="u1687bca4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">m=audio 16394 RTP/AVP 8 101</span></p>
<p id="ucefbcf10" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a=rtpmap:101 telephone-event/8000</span></p>
<p id="u0394c0e1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a=fmtp:101 0-16</span></p>
<p id="ua7159c63" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="ud8a1c1b1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">经过kamailio转发后的200OK。</span></p>
<p id="u4f6f3412" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">m=audio 31724 RTP/AVP 8</span></p>
<p id="u3d52c905" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u24d4040c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">A路sdp中dtmf的payload为97，kaimailio正常透传，B路响应sdp中dtmf的payload为101，经过kamailio+rtpengine处理后，sdp中的dtmf编码被删除了。</span></p>
<p id="ua65c622c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">通话接通后，A路按键发送DTMF码，采用inband波形模式，B路无法正常识别。</span></p>
<h1 id="femOG"><span class="ne-text">修复</span></h1>
<p id="ua4409796" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">问题的本质是B路响应的sdp中dtmf的payload被删除了，但是媒体通道并没有受影响，媒体转发也没有任何问题，所以最直接的办法就是在kamailio的cfg配置中再把payload加回去。</span></p>
<p id="u3fc4bd7b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改kamailio.cfg文件，主要修改如下。</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-dockerfile" data-language="dockerfile"><code>...
modparam("rtpengine", "write_sdp_pv", "$avp(sdp)")
...
route[RESET_DTMF]{
	xinfo("route[RESET_DTMF]\n");
	# reset DTMF payload
	if(search_body("telephone-event/8000") &amp;&amp; !search_str($avp(sdp), "telephone-event/8000")) 
	{
		xinfo("Added DTMF 101 payload to SDP\n");

		$avp(sdp) = $(avp(sdp){re.subst,/^(m=audio.* 8)/\1 101/});
		$avp(sdp) = $(avp(sdp){re.subst,/^(a=rtpmap:8 PCMA.*)$/\1\na=rtpmap:101 telephone-event\/8000\na=fmtp:101 0-15/});

		set_body("$avp(sdp)", "application/sdp");
	}
	else {
		xinfo("DTMF 101 payload already exists in SDP\n");
		set_body("$avp(sdp)", "application/sdp");
	}

	return;
}

route[RTPENGINE] {
	xinfo("route[RTPENGINE]\n");

	# check if have sdp
	if (!has_body("application/sdp"))
	{
		xinfo("!has_body(application/sdp)\n");
		return;
	}

	if(ds_is_from_list("3060") || ds_is_from_list("3061"))
	{
		xinfo("route[RTPENGINE], 3060|3061\n");
		# from pub, to priv
		rtpengine_manage("replace-origin replace-session-connection direction=pub direction=priv ");
		set_body("$avp(sdp)", "application/sdp");
	}
	else if(ds_is_from_list("5060"))
	{
		xinfo("route[RTPENGINE], 5060\n");
		# from priv, to pub
		rtpengine_manage("replace-origin replace-session-connection direction=priv direction=pub ");

		route(RESET_DTMF);
	}

	return;
}
</code></pre>
<p id="u6ac8882e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">思路就是针对AB路会有不同payload的场景，调用route(RESET_DTMF)，在PCMA编码的后面加上payload=101的编码。</span></p>
<h1 id="z22qb"><span class="ne-text">测试</span></h1>
<p id="ua2d61323" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">重启kamailio，发起呼叫。</span></p>
<p id="u274dbac2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">从信令中看到，经过kamailio处理后的200OK的sdp中增加了payload=101的dtmf编码。</span></p>
<p id="u36afbc94" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">A路按键测试，可以看到rtpengine正常转发了dtmf码。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2500940/202510/2500940-20251031172603531-1524282055.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="Dwflh"><span class="ne-text">总结</span></h1>
<p id="uf7c1131f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">kamailio+rtpengine作为媒体代理的方式简单易用，转发效率高，不会修改媒体包的内容，rtp和rtcp都可以正常透传转发。</span></p>
<p id="u8c81d330" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u6ea52b7c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">空空如常</span></p>
<p id="u45992f0e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">求真得真</span></p>
